INVITE sip:[service]@[remote_ip]:[remote_port] SIP/2.0 Via: SIP/2.0/UDP [local_ip]:[local_port];branch=[branch] From: "Test Caller" <sip:1000@[local_ip]:[local_port]>;tag=[call_number] To: <sip:1000@[remote_ip]:[remote_port]> Call-ID: [call_id] CSeq: 2 INVITE Contact: <sip:1000@[local_ip]:[local_port]> Max-Forwards: 70 [authentication username=1000 password=password] Content-Type: application/sdp Content-Length: [len]
